review.supports: Native actor interaction and reference lifetime, including collector disposal.

native_lifecycle.supports: Native destruction and restored missing destinations remain accepted by planned dispatch; manual validation rejects dead references; existing replacement repair preserves valid routes.

planner_replay.supports: Captured retired-target replay matches saved route duration under declared fixture boundaries.

repaired_lifecycle.supports: Production removal/restoration hooks execute native destruction, restoration, command failure, replacement and failed/nested replacement. Captured O-ZY3A route is cleared without changing motion/fuel; weak references release and unchanged restoration allocates zero.

target_kind.description: Identity-bearing target versus an independent point or stellar object.

lifetime.description: Hidden is not destroyed; replacement preserves logical identity.

registry.description: Whether the logical ship destination resolves in the system.

scan_ref.description: Observer Ship reference, separate from saved ID and situation.

situation.description: Orphan means a retained locked situation has lost its body reference.

shared.description: Observer uses the exact destination ShipSitu rather than an owned waypoint.

lock.description: Anchored situations pass HasValidPathTarget; free targets use manual flight.

plan.description: Divergent is the captured numerical outcome, not every possible malformed route.

ports.description: Nonstation docking-port availability is separate from target lifetime.

collector.description: Concurrent retrieval actor progression for the same wreck.

goal.description: Destination assigned versus cleared; coordinate destinations need not have a registry ID.

collision.description: Native collision prediction may divert anchored flight into the manual child.
